race.comment: BLAZING HARRY (1) has found the line well but been unable to reel in the in-form Braveheart at his last two appearances, most recently last Saturday over 1200m at this track. Needs the longer trip at this stage of the prep and there is no Braveheart today. He is ready to win. GAMBINO (3) was most impressive over 1400m at Eagle Farm a fortnight back, racing back in the field from a wide draw then lengthening in great style to get the prize. Goes up 6kgs today but is racing too well to rule out. ARATIRI (12) just missed in an encouraging return over 1200m at Eagle Farm 24 days ago. Proved herself at Saturday level last prep. Should be thereabouts. HOT MAJESTY (10) will no odubt be better over further, though this looks a suitable kick off point. Can return on a positive note.
